command: set -o pipefail; { set +e; ANTINAT_P18_TEST_ABORT_AFTER_ROLLBACK=1 bash scripts/test-systemd.sh; abort_status=$?; set -e; printf 'intentional_abort_status=%s\n' "$abort_status"; if [[ "$abort_status" != 99 ]]; then exit 1; fi; for path in /opt/antinat /var/lib/antinat /var/log/antinat /etc/antinat /etc/systemd/system/antinat-agent.service /etc/systemd/system/antinat-controller.service /etc/systemd/system/antinat-agent.service.d/p18-native-test.conf; do if [[ -e "$path" || -L "$path" ]]; then exit 1; fi; done; if id antinat >/dev/null 2>&1 || getent group antinat >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi; echo 'intentional failure cleanup: PASS'; } 2>&1 | tee .hermes/evidence/p18/systemd-failure-cleanup.log && { for run in 1 2 3; do echo "systemd stability run $run/3"; bash scripts/test-systemd.sh || exit 1; done; } 2>&1 | tee .hermes/evidence/p18/systemd-smoke.log
summary: Shipped signed installer completed three consecutive real Controller and Agent install, TLS enrollment, restart, failed-upgrade rollback, successful upgrade, durable online uninstall receipt, purge, and no-residue runs; a separate intentional post-rollback abort also proved trap cleanup leaves no installation resources or account.
